about: E02 shipped material presets (scripts/material_library.gd reads this; the user's own presets live in user://material_library.json, never here). Metals: 'f0' is the LINEAR specular reflectance at normal incidence from the commonly used PBR charts (N. Hoffman, 'Physics and Math of Shading', SIGGRAPH 2015 course, table of F0 for metals; the same values as S. Lagarde's DONTNOD chart); the base colour is f0 converted to sRGB, metallic 1. Dielectrics: 'albedo' in sRGB 0-255, every channel inside 30..240 (the Substance / Unreal PBR guides' plausible range), metallic 0. Skin: Monk Skin Tone scale swatches (E. Monk, Google 2022) MST 4/6/8/10, subsurface on; E18 replaces them with colorimetric data.

presets.name: Canvas gi
presets.source: unbleached heavy cotton canvas (judo / karate gi)

presets.name: Leather (black)
presets.source: dyed black leather; kept at the 30 sRGB floor (charcoal is about 50, nothing real is below 30)

presets.name: Brushed steel
presets.source: Hoffman 2015 F0 of iron; the brushing is roughness only (no anisotropy field on a slot)

presets.name: Blackened steel
presets.source: a black-oxide (magnetite) coat: the surface the light meets is an oxide, so it is a dielectric (the PBR guides: oxides and rust are metallic 0)

presets.name: Rusted iron
presets.source: iron oxide (rust) is a dielectric: metallic 0, red-brown albedo

presets.name: Bronze
presets.source: not in Hoffman's table: copper's F0 (0.955, 0.638, 0.538) moved toward tin (yellower, darker), an estimate inside the metal range
